Notes (hand-added after the run, the JSON block above is generated):
- App state during the soak: teacher review disabled (`configs/app.yaml` local override); it was enabled only for the
  preceding smoke test and is off in normal operation.
- The GPU ran the phase-2 benchmarks earlier on 2026-11-18; once they finished nothing else used the GPU for the
  whole 8 h window (desktop compositor only), so drift numbers are clean.
- The full pipeline was freshly restarted before the soak began; all ten cameras show uptime 0.9998 for this worker
  run, 0 restarts and 0 reconnects over 2874 samples (0 sample errors, full 8.0 h span).
- Events/hour remain inflated by the looping demo clips (same workers re-enter as new tracks); not an operational
  alert rate — see docs/benchmarks/README.md §4.
